# Local Development Notes

## Running tests

Install the devcontainer CLI first:

```bash
npm install -g @devcontainers/cli
```

> Note: the `devcontainer` CLI installed by the VS Code Dev Containers extension does not work properly — use the npm install above.

Then run tests:

```bash
# Default tests for a feature (autogenerated, default option values)
devcontainer features test -f <feature> --skip-scenarios .

# Scenario tests (test/<feature>/scenarios.json + matching .sh files)
devcontainer features test -f <feature> --skip-autogenerated --skip-duplicated .

# Against a specific base image
devcontainer features test -f <feature> -i mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/base:ubuntu --skip-scenarios .
```
